text:
Micah: hi everyone — Micah here, started today in eng-runtime. Trying to bootstrap my dev env on a Windows laptop (Win11). Using WSL2 + Ubuntu. Installed asdf but hitting plugin/install errors around openssl. any quick pointers?
Jamila: welcome! :wave: we usually run the toolchain inside WSL. which shell are you using (bash/zsh/fish)?
Micah: default WSL bash for now. the asdf plugin install for python/node fails with compile errors: 'error: missing openssl'.
Aaron: that usually means libssl-dev + build deps missing in WSL. try: `sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential libssl-dev libbz2-dev libreadline-dev libsqlite3-dev llvm libncurses5-dev xz-utils tk-dev libffi-dev liblzma-dev`
Micah: thanks. for nodejs i also saw gpg import failures: 'gpg: keyserver receive failed'. Is there a recommended sequence for the nodejs plugin?
Becky: @Micah for nodejs we do: `asdf plugin-add nodejs https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs.git` then run the helper: `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring`. Also ensure `gnupg` is installed in WSL.
Micah: got it. quick question about dotfiles — do we have a canonical repo or setup script?
Jamila: yep we have an internal starter at github.com/redwood-inference/dotfiles-starter. run `./install.sh` which symlinks and sets up direnv. there's a `.envrc.example` you can copy to `.envrc` and run `direnv allow`.
Micah: env vars: where do i get REDWOOD_API_KEY and local creds? should i request access from SRE?
Aaron: for dev-local you can use the dev token in Vault. ping @Becky and she'll add you to the dev path. or set `REDWOOD_API_KEY=dev_local_key` temporarily (don't commit).
Becky: invited you to Vault and added a dev token, and added you to the aws-dev group. note: if you need to pull private docker images set `DOCKER_CONFIG` with your creds.
Micah: thanks! docker-compose in WSL failed with permission denied on /var/run/docker.sock. anyone seen that?
DevOps Bot: Tip: if using Docker Desktop + WSL integration, enable WSL backend and add your WSL user to the docker group: `sudo usermod -aG docker $USER && newgrp docker`.
Micah: that fixed it after a logout/login. last Q: recommended VS Code extensions and remote settings?
Jamila: use Remote - WSL, Python, Prettier, ESLint, EditorConfig, direnv, TOML. we also enable settings sync on the company account and add a `launch.json` for attaching to local services.
Micah: perfect, getting there — will ping if anything else blocks. thanks for the quick help! :pray:
Becky: welcome aboard Micah! :tada:
